Hi Laura,

Thanks again for confirming the May 12–14 executive & technical workshop at Redwood HQ. We need to lock room blocks and a small number of extended-stay rooms for a few execs. Can you confirm the hotels you're recommending, the group rate, and whether we can get a standard contract (we do our payments centrally and need invoice details)? Hi Alex — thanks for the details and heads-up. Quick summary and next steps below.

Hotels we recommend (walking distance to Redwood HQ):
- The Rosedale Hotel — negotiated group rate: $249/night (includes breakfast), 20 rooms held in a block.
- Parkside Suites — executive suite options; $319/night; 5 extended-stay rooms (kitchenette).
- Harbor Inn — budget option, $179/night; 15 rooms.

I attached a rooming_list_template.xlsx that captures name, arrival/departure, room type, bed preference, frequent-flyer, and whether traveler needs invoice on booking. If you can return that by Tue 10 Mar we'll submit rooming and hold blocks through March 17.

About billing/contract: Monica (copied) will send the hotel contract draft and confirm if hotels will invoice Acme directly or if Redwood needs to prepay and invoice you.

If you want a quick call, I'm free Thu 4–5pm PT.

Best,
Laura Bennett

Alex / Laura,

Thanks — I spoke to the Rosedale events rep. Key points:
- Group rate confirmed at $249 for standard rooms, $279 for king. Free Wi-Fi and breakfast buffet included.
- They will hold the block until 2026-03-17; release is 30 days before arrival (2026-04-12) unless we provide a rooming list or a credit card guarantee.
- They can invoice Acme Health directly (net 30) but require an org-level PO and the signed hotel contract.
- We prepared a short hotel_contract_draft.pdf — this includes the standard attrition clause, early departure policy, and a small pickup guarantee. See attached.

Action items:
1) Alex — please confirm whether Acme's travel team will provide PO/terms or prefer Redwood to guarantee with Redwood's card and invoice Acme.
2) Alex/Sofia — complete the attached rooming_list_template.xlsx and return it to me.
3) Rishi — can you confirm whether Redwood can provide complimentary shuttle from airport for two coach pickup windows (May 12 morning arrival and May 14 late-night departures)?

- May 12 — two 9:30am and 11:30am coach pick-ups (from SFO).
